name: Gas Furnace Maintenance
summary:
Gas Furnace Maintenance is an immersive VR training application developed as part of the Immerse Learn Gas Furnace Maintenance micro-credential program. This app enables learners to practice essential skills in a safe, simulated environment, including furnace inspection, component identification, cleaning, maintenance procedures, and safety protocols.
